source_name: DRCIP — Registrar of Companies (open CSV + eSearch)
organization: Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCIP)
license: Open data (data.gov.cy; confirm exact licence per dataset)
record_shape: one_row_per_organisation_csv (companies); officers in a related CSV keyed by registration_number

fields.meaning: DRCIP registration number and the company id. The prefix encodes the entity type: HE/ΗΕ = limited company (the common case), BN/ΕΕ = business name, EE/ΟΕ/ΕΕ = partnership, AE/ΑΕΖ/S = overseas/other.
fields.limitations: Prefix-to-type meaning is documented, not a published code table. Schematic example value (no per-company open record was downloadable here).
fields.analysis_notes: Use directly as company_id and the join key for all other Cyprus sources.

fields.meaning: Registered organisation name. The register holds Greek and/or English forms where available.
fields.limitations: May carry only one script depending on the filing; historical/previous names not guaranteed in the open CSV.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary display name. Preserve both Greek and English where present.

fields.meaning: Entity type: company (limited), business name, partnership, or overseas company. Correlates with the registration_number prefix.
fields.limitations: Ltd vs Plc distinction usually inferred from the name suffix, not a separate field.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to company_type; refine Ltd/Plc from the name.

fields.meaning: Lifecycle status of the organisation: operational, struck-off, dissolved, under liquidation, etc.
fields.limitations: Status label set is not published as a formal code list; normalise on ingest.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to internal status; treat 'operational' as active.

fields.meaning: Date the organisation was registered (incorporation date for companies).
fields.limitations: Date format in the raw CSV unconfirmed here; normalise to ISO 8601 on ingest.

fields.meaning: Registered office address of the organisation.
fields.limitations: Likely a single free-text line; municipality/district must be parsed out, not a separate field.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to registered_address; derive municipality/region (Nicosia/Limassol/Larnaca/Paphos/Famagusta) by parsing.

fields.meaning: Named officers — directors and the company secretary — associated with the company. Present in the open CSV/related officers file.
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA (GDPR). The register names officers (directors/secretary) but NOT shareholders. No date-of-birth/address expected in the open set.
fields.analysis_notes: Officer list confirmed via OpenSanctions cy_companies (~2.75M entities). Apply a GDPR lawful basis + retention policy before persisting.

fields.meaning: Role of the officer: director or secretary.
fields.limitations: Role vocabulary not formally published; normalise on ingest.
fields.analysis_notes: Officer ⇒ company relationship; shareholders are not in the open data.
